text: Indoor lab automation setup against a pale grey wall. Centre-left: a black rack with several cylindrical wells, most empty; one tube stands upright in it carrying an orange screw cap, its body holding pinkish-red liquid. Behind the rack sits a blue finned/ribbed module with small metal fittings on top. Left of centre, a white square housing with a dark circular opening sits on a white shelf, beside a rail with black rollers and a QR/ArUco marker label. A vertical grey aluminium extrusion column with bolt heads runs up the right side, topped by a magenta sign with a black marker. Another marker card is mounted low centre. Right edge: white worktop, aluminium rails and a dark screen. Signage reads "...ion Area".
